summary: A faster, more accurate UT Dining.

changes.title: Instant launch
changes.description: Menus you have already loaded show right away, even before a sync finishes.

changes.title: Faster menu switching
changes.description: Changing meals, dates and locations no longer has a delay.

changes.title: Smarter syncing
changes.description: Only the menu days that changed are downloaded, and a failed sync keeps your saved menus.

changes.title: More accurate allergens and nutrition
changes.description: Every recipe now keeps its full allergen list, and unknown nutrients are left blank instead of showing 0.

changes.title: Liquid Glass tab bar
changes.description: The tab bar uses the new iOS look and follows the in-app dark mode setting.

changes.title: What's New
changes.description: See what changed after every update, or anytime from Settings.

changes.title: Fixes
changes.description: Food details match the selected date, hours stay current after a sync, food card swipes work again, and the map sheet updates when you tap another pin.

changes.title: Faster menu loading
changes.description: Menus load with fewer database queries.

changes.title: Fixed a bug that kept food's nutrition information from loading
Refreshed dark mode
changes.description: A cleaner color palette with better contrast and spacing for easier reading.

changes.title: Decimal quantities in the Meal Planner
changes.description: Enter fractional quantities like 0.5 servings for more accurate planning.

changes.title: Past and future menus
changes.description: Know what is being served before and after you go.

changes.title: 50+ new locations
changes.description: Food trucks, new restaurants, cafés and more.

changes.title: Push notifications
changes.description: Get alerts about closures, hours and new menus.

changes.title: Offline mode
changes.description: Access menus and hours without a connection.

changes.title: Refreshed design
changes.description: Sleeker, smoother and easier to navigate.
